label: Milch ab Hof
note: Ordinary raw milk sold only at the farm gate, not Vorzugsmilch; it must carry a boil-before-drinking notice

about.text: Raw milk sold directly on the farm under a registration, not the certified kind; the buyer is told to boil it before drinking.

picture.file: Milk and cheese vending machine in Niedeck, district Göttingen, Milchautomat 01.jpg
picture.author: Nemracc

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: There is no step at all: the milk goes from the cooler or machine into the customer own bottle, which is exactly why the law demands the boil-before-drinking notice.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

facts.v: The farmer, at the farm gate; no special hygiene requirements beyond ordinary milk production (BfR), unlike Vorzugsmilch from specially controlled farms
The point of sale must show a clear notice: Rohmilch, vor dem Verzehr abkochen
BfR: always boil it before drinking; children, pregnant women, the old and the ill should avoid raw milk and raw-milk products
Handing it to canteens, hospital kitchens and other communal catering
From the farm own herd, milked the same day or the day before, sale reported to the authority beforehand (Landkreis München / Hessen leaflet, secondary)
